IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseParquetFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseParquetFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET)
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'synapse-container_hemanthadlsgen2_dfs_core_windows_net') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [synapse-container_hemanthadlsgen2_dfs_core_windows_net] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://synapse-container@hemanthadlsgen2.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.house (
	[price] bigint,
	[area] bigint,
	[bedrooms] bigint,
	[bathrooms] bigint,
	[stories] bigint,
	[mainroad] nvarchar(4000),
	[guestroom] nvarchar(4000),
	[basement] nvarchar(4000),
	[hotwaterheating] nvarchar(4000),
	[airconditioning] nvarchar(4000),
	[parking] bigint,
	[prefarea] nvarchar(4000),
	[furnishingstatus] nvarchar(4000)
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'house-price.parquet',
	DATA_SOURCE = [synapse-container_hemanthadlsgen2_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseParquetFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.house
GO
